description_en: Obtains the last resource inventory that is generated on the Global Resources page within the current account group
description_zh: 获取指定的账号组内最近一次生成的全局资源下载清单信息
name: GetAggregateResourceInventory

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the account group.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of an account group, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

ResourceInventory.description_en: The information about the resource inventory
ResourceInventory.description_zh: 全局资源下载清单信息

DownloadUrl.description_en: The download URL of the resource inventory
DownloadUrl.description_zh: 全局资源清单下载地址

ResourceInventoryGenerateTime.description_en:
The time when the resource inventory was generated. The value is a timestamp.

Unit: milliseconds
ResourceInventoryGenerateTime.description_zh:
生成全局资源下载清单的时间戳。

单位：毫秒

Status.description_en:
The generation status of the resource inventory. Valid values:

CREATING: The resource inventory is being generated.
COMPLETE: The resource inventory is generated
Status.description_zh:
全局资源下载清单的生成状态。取值：

CREATING：生成中。

COMPLETE：生成完成
